scope: One fresh Kind Kubernetes v1.36.1 cluster runs a read-only Python validator Job over abstract, non-operational incident records and a defensive classification/traceability/ownership worksheet. The Job independently validates a deliberately incomplete/misclassified baseline and a complete candidate worksheet, then checks a permitted synthetic positive record. Raw JSON and stable summary evidence are captured. CTA-2114 normative taxonomy text is not publicly accessible in the verified source; the control's asserted class labels are tracked as unverified, with NIST AI 100-2e2025 shown separately as comparator. This does not establish production coverage, incident attribution, or CTA conformance.

checks.claim: The worksheet catches missing links and invalid observations
The worksheet accepts completed links and evidence-backed classifications
An independent observation maps to a known owned class
